newsitem.title: UK: LVMH buys more Grand Met shares.
newsitem.headline: LVMH buys more Grand Met shares.

text.p: French luxury goods group LVMH bought a further 250,000 shares in British food and drinks company Grand Metropolitan to increase its stake to 6.3 percent, Grand Met said on Tuesday.

Last week, LVMH Chairman Bernard Arnault took the market by surprise when he snapped up a 6.29 percent stake in Grand Met in what analysts say is an attempt by LVMH to leverage a better negotiating position in the planned merger of Grand Met and Guinness.
Grand Met said LVMH now holds 132.7 million shares in Grand Met. LVMH is the biggest single shareholder in both would-be partners. It holds a 14.2 percent stake in Guinness.

Last week, Guinness and Grand Met said they expected the proposed merger to become effective by the end of the year. The European Commission said it has started a full probe into the deal and should reach a decision by the end of October, the companies said.
The planned merger would create GMG Brands, worth more than 20 billion pounds, which would be the world's leader in wine and spirits.
